Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1083
Claimant:
Lindsey Smith

Alison Sweeney
6 May 2023
Claim opened for a low-speed collision in a parking lot involving two vehicles. The claimant reports neck pain and has
retained counsel, so all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
9 May 2023
Reviewed the claimant's policy and confirmed the driver is named on it. Coverage was in force at the time of the loss.
13 May 2023
Obtained the police report and witness statements. Both confirm the claimant was seated in the veihcle when the
impact occurred, and the other driver describes the accident the same way.
19 Jun 2023
Photos from the scene and the repair estimate were reviewed. The damage is largely consistent with the impact
described, though a few old scratches on the rear bumper may predate this loss and have been noted separately.
11 Jul 2023
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who provided the initial medical records. The whiplash diagnosis fits the type and
force of the collision well, and no prior injury to the neck has been identified in the records received.
5 Sep 2023
Claimant's account has stayed consistent across every conversation, incluidng the recorded statement and the
follow-up call with counsel present. Treatment has continued somehwat longer than is typical for this injury, so the
medical file is being reviewed.
8 Oct 2023
Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy's effective date. Reserve reviewed and claim remains
under evaluation pending the completed treatment records.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
